description: This file defines the PaymentMethodInterface interface, which specifies the contract that all payment methods must implement within the Goteo project. It includes method signatures related to payment processing, such as initialization, purchase, refund, and status checks, as well as properties like the associated invest and request objects.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the payment method with a User object.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Static method to retrieve the identifier of the payment method, marked as deprecated.

methods.name: getIdNonStatic
methods.description: Returns the non-static identifier of the payment method.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name or label of the payment method.

methods.name: getDesc
methods.description: Provides a short description of the payment method.

methods.name: getIcon
methods.description: Returns an icon representing the payment method.

methods.name: isActive
methods.description: Determines if the payment method is active and can be used, optionally based on amount.

methods.name: isPublic
methods.description: Checks if the payment method is public and available for user-initiated payments.

methods.name: setInvest
methods.description: Associates an Invest object with the payment method.

methods.name: getInvest
methods.description: Retrieves the associated Invest object.

methods.name: setRequest
methods.description: Sets the Symfony HTTP request object for the payment method.

methods.name: getDefaultHttpResponse
methods.description: Provides a redirect response after purchase completion, if applicable.

methods.name: getRequest
methods.description: Retrieves the current HTTP request associated with the payment method.

methods.name: purchase
methods.description: Initiates the purchase process when a user confirms a payment.

methods.name: completePurchase
methods.description: Completes the purchase process upon return or notification from the payment gateway.

methods.name: refundable
methods.description: Checks if the payment method supports refunds.

methods.name: refund
methods.description: Processes a refund through the payment gateway.

methods.name: calculateCommission
methods.description: Calculates fees associated with the transaction, following common fee structures.

methods.name: isInternal
methods.description: Indicates whether the payment method is an internal (non-cash) payment.

methods.name: isSubscription
methods.description: Indicates if the payment method supports recurring payments.
